networks.name: neighborhood_hub
networks.description: Discover Oakwood local food, home repair/errand services, and clinic/tutoring/tool bookings—ask partner assistants after your approval and build an actionable local plan.
sample_queries: Which local businesses are in the Oakwood directory and what can each help with?
Ask Hearth & Crumb Kitchen what kinds of food and dietary options it offers.
I need a leaky sink fixed and a tutoring session—ask CivicFix and Oakwood Scheduling what they offer and add both to my plan.
Can you take my credit card number here or dispatch 911 emergency services?

peer_policy.note: Calls only the partner sites in allowed_peers after the visitor agrees on the consent card.

agent_mcp.reason: This is a static bundle; a public MCP facade requires an application host.
